programme.title: Study Bachelor of Computer Science at Adelaide University - Information for International students | Adelaide University
programme.degree: Bachelor of Computer Science (program code BCOMP, CRICOS 115685K), 3 years full-time; majors AI and Machine Learning, Human-Centred Computing, Programming Languages; Adelaide City Campus / Mawson Lakes
programme.how_found: adelaide.edu.au -> Study (degree finder) -> Computer Science & Information Technology; degree URL confirmed by search (official domain only); 2027 international view.
programme.notes: Adelaide University (from 2026, successor of the University of Adelaide and UniSA). English-taught (Australia); no language quote drafted.

english.quote: IELTS Overall 6.5 IELTS Reading 6 IELTS Listening 6 IELTS Speaking 6 IELTS Writing 6
english.notes: Programme page, 2027 international view. Within two years prior to admission; equivalent tests listed on a separate page.

value.description: No GPA scale: country-by-country minimum by qualification (e.g. IB 26, ATAR 75, Gaokao 65%, French Baccalaureate 11.5, OSSD 70%).

gpa.notes: 'International admissions by country' table on the programme page; meeting it 'does not, in itself, guarantee a place'.

deadline.notes: No closing date on the programme page or the international how-to-apply page ('Check the application closing date for your chosen degree.'); the FAQ 'When is the last date to apply?' lives on ask.adelaideuni.edu.au, whose robots.txt disallows the answer pages for our user agent (and the host is not adelaide.edu.au). Intakes: Semester 1 and Semester 2 are listed on the page.

tuition.quote: Fees are based on the total number of units studied in this program on a full-time annual basis. $55,400
tuition.notes: 'Indicative annual fees'; 'Fees are subject to change annually.' Commencement year 2027, international view.

scholarship_exists.quote: Recipients are offered a 50% tuition fee reduction.
scholarship_exists.notes: 'There are limited places for those with a high distinction average. To apply, international students need to complete an application form.' Others: Emerging Leaders Award 25% (distinction average, automatic), Merit Scholarship 15% (credit average, automatic). Tuition reduction only: PARTIAL.

scholarship_international.quote: Adelaide University offers a range of scholarships of up to 50% for international students.
